items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Charlie and Lem Johnson and all, were some little young cats like I had come up as a little youngster

ctx.x: I know that. And anyway, Charlie and Lem Johnson and all, were some little young cats like I had come up as a little youngster, because I'm older than Charlie, and you know, they're coming up, and they were the little cats of that time, so anyway, in order to get us out of Oklahoma City, the Southern Serenaders, at that time, said okay, said what we'll do is to play a battle of music up into Slaughter's Hall, and we'll give you all the proceeds so you can go home.
What town was that, you had the Slaughter's Hall in?
